independent_rejection_rules: Duplicate table columns, duplicate pixel pairs or observation image references
Out-of-range, negative, boolean or dangling table indices
Missing objects, ROI/view negative pixel rows or unsupported-object partition entries
Readability inconsistent with front and actual shared 16/4/24 counts
Coverage or image/delivery counts inconsistent with actual observations
Wrong native block position, PNG SHA, MIME or dimensions
Zero ROI reported as complete or covered prediction without observation
Unknown fields outside the frozen brief contract

index_semantics.native_content_block_index: Actual zero-based MCP content array position. First image has value 1 because content[0] is the text block.
index_semantics.object_index: Zero-based row of the complete objects table, with object_index equal to that row.
index_semantics.region_index: Zero-based row of the complete regions table.

omission_semantics.coverage: Absent observed_views and the three *_region_indices lists mean empty collections. scope and state_updates remain required.
omission_semantics.pixel_rules: May be absent or {} only when there are no pixel rows. No implicit threshold values are added to an empty observation.
omission_semantics.tables: objects/regions/images/observations/pixels may be absent only to mean an empty table. Nonempty tables require the exact columns and rows representation.
omission_semantics.unsupported_objects: Absent scope.objects_without_supported_roi means empty. Nonempty values use the declared object_index/status table.

preparation_execution: Historical JSON and AST reads only. No product/projector/schema/decoder/test/camera/raster call. Root executes the frozen contract later.

semantic_source_map.binding: All original identity/provenance fields except objects, camera_policy and schema. capture_state selection_key is excluded. The three source_status/disk_status/source_check_scope fields remain.
semantic_source_map.coverage: facts.coverage including all covered, unresolved and finite-pool lists, observed view order, state_updates and scope.
semantic_source_map.image_delivery: All original five delivery counters/status fields and facts.image_delivery_scope. Local validation, MCP construction and consumer/model confirmation remain distinct.
semantic_source_map.images: frames view/ref/SHA plus actual native block position. Frame scene/camera/hostbinding/revision aliases must match the retained binding before they can be omitted.
semantic_source_map.objects: binding.objects mapped exactly once, preserving all host IDs, names, instances and capture order.
semantic_source_map.observations: facts.observations without local image_path. Every image, readable reference and full ROI/view pixel row is retained, including all negative rows.
semantic_source_map.pixel_rules: Actual shared 16/4/24 fields from every original pixel row. Rules are not fabricated when no rows exist.
semantic_source_map.regions: facts.regions. Host/name/instance aliases are restored from objects and must originally agree.
semantic_source_map.scope: facts.scope including counts, exact domain, all-object occlusion meaning, and every unsupported object with its original status.
